description: Defines the ExtendedDisplayIdentification class and related nested classes for handling EDID data, including parsing display info, color formats, timing, and segments.

classes.name: ExtendedDisplayIdentification
classes.description: Represents extended display identification data, including parsing and validation of EDID segments, manufacturer info, color formats, and display timings.

classes.name: ExtendedDisplayIdentification::Buffer
classes.description: Manages a fixed-size buffer for EDID data blocks.

classes.name: ExtendedDisplayIdentification::Iterator
classes.description: Iterates over EDID segment buffers, providing access to segment types and data.

classes.name: ExtendedDisplayIdentification::CEA
classes.description: Handles CEA extension blocks within EDID, parsing data blocks such as audio, video, vendor-specific info, and capabilities.

classes.name: ExtendedDisplayIdentification::CEA::DataBlockIterator
classes.description: Iterates over data blocks within a CEA extension, providing access to block type, size, and content.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the EDID data is valid based on header bytes.

methods.name: Raw
methods.description: Copies raw EDID data into provided buffer.

methods.name: Manufacturer
methods.description: Returns the manufacturer code as a string.

methods.name: ProductCode
methods.description: Returns the product code.

methods.name: Serial
methods.description: Returns the serial number.

methods.name: Week
methods.description: Returns the manufacturing week.

methods.name: Year
methods.description: Returns the manufacturing year.

methods.name: Major
methods.description: Returns the major version of EDID.

methods.name: Minor
methods.description: Returns the minor version of EDID.

methods.name: Digital
methods.description: Indicates if display is digital.

methods.name: BitsPerColor
methods.description: Returns bits per color.

methods.name: ColorDepth
methods.description: Returns color depth setting.

methods.name: DisplayType
methods.description: Returns display type and color format flags.

methods.name: VideoInterface
methods.description: Returns the video interface type.

methods.name: Extensions
methods.description: Returns an iterator over EDID extensions.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns total length of EDID data.

methods.name: Segments
methods.description: Returns number of EDID segments.

methods.name: Segment
methods.description: Returns pointer to specific segment data.

methods.name: CEASegment
methods.description: Returns iterator to the CEA extension segment.

methods.name: WidthInCentimeters
methods.description: Returns display width in centimeters.

methods.name: HeightInCentimeters
methods.description: Returns display height in centimeters.

methods.name: PreferredWidthInPixels
methods.description: Returns preferred display width in pixels.

methods.name: PreferredHeightInPixels
methods.description: Returns preferred display height in pixels.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets EDID data to default state.
